notes.title: DEMO OUT! (WITH NEW TRAILER)
notes.content:
[h1]Ûnsae[/h1][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3tG1A5rvcxo"][/dynamiclink]The Demo is out!
We gave it everything. And we have every intention to keep giving.

We know choices we have made along the way will resonate with a specific type of crowd. This is an open invitation for you to find out if you are one of them!

Our plan is now to polish things up as we head into Next Fest with this demo.

Note that we are doing simultaneous work on both the demo and the rest of the game.
Of course we will try to prioritize anything of importance that pops up. Just know that our focus is two fold.

Many thanks to the great [b]Jullian Champenois[/b], aka Disco Elysiums Kim, for narrating the trailer.

And to the amazing music by the amazing Riotbard of[url="https://(snowdaymedia.net)"] snowdaymedia.net[/url]

It shows off a lot of the love that has gone into the world and it's design. Endless paper notes and work on symbols and meanings.

We try to put meaning in everything we do as we work our way through thousands of assets. With a project of this scope we have taken every bit of help along the way we could. And for every time we have been tempted to cut corners we've then been inspired to turn the corner into a full roundabout.

I can tell you now, how happy we are to be here finally that we can talk to you now more openly about the world we've been cooking.

Dynasthir to us is more than a game. The amount of short stories written. The endless notes and sketches. The mechanics of the world that exist mostly in the form of a rough outline for it's ancient pen & paper roleplaying game roots. It's become part of our lives in a way hard to describe. 

As the world around us was dying in 2019. We were already asking the question.. Will we persist? 
And damn it, it seems like through every hardship. Here we are.

It's time to start the journey! The first chapter of Dynasthir beckons.

- Ulfgang & Mireneye
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725869/3810d230d5166c1468e838af89421b04b3e5f327.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Home stretch
notes.content:
[h1]Ûnsae[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725869/e6882ce21c6f4f43f7a9d49d0ce7e9f41905522f.png"][/img]
We are currently working on what will be the last version of our demo. The one that will eventually be open for the public. No more closed doors working away in the shadows; exposed for all to see.

But it is and has not been our only focus. Concurrently we have been working on the upcoming chapters of the game. It's coming along well, more on that soon!

We have also been looking more into Steam Deck. It's a tough nut. According to the internet it's [b]only[/b] 400% less powerful than our PC Hardware Target ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][p]
But maybe, just maybe we can get it running at locked 30. In our testing it will be a real challenge. And I can tell immediately it will be something we will have to work towards after the initial PC release.

The game has never felt better, now it is just a matter of getting it in your hands, so you can feel for yourself.

I'm as always concerned that it doesn't look good enough or doesn't perform well enough. It's something I will always be working towards. It's true until the game is release & it will be true for a long time after.

Your patience has paid off; big news soon!
Beyond patience, will you persist?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725869/a17e14bb74123b6c0ce885588bdd5ca1fb84a68f.jpg"][/img]
[/p]

notes.title: Patch Demo Branch. For Speed!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Players![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725869/abffd5d333b455eba73616dc2ef88c608f27250d.jpg[/img]

With this build we put our all into preparing for the upcoming Speedrun Compeition (13/05/2024). More about that if you look to our Events. This build also boasts two big updates to our NPC backend, which should improve FPS and frame pacing across the board & not only that! A lot of animations have gotten more polish!

Here are the big changes to the current Live build:
[list]
[*]Balance patch to Damage, enemy Health & Boss Health
[*]Move-set polish across many Player Move-sets
[*]Player foot placement now works properly
[*]Reworked Backstab backend logic
[*]Possessed Boss should look a little bit more menacing (he might be)
[*]Made a majority of stationary NPCs GPU bound instead of CPU bound
[*]Optimization to Character Rendering
[*]More Distance culling optimizations
[/list]
Note
[list]
[*]The Running Nekath event is not completable (to our knowledge)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725869/4417a85f8dd2007f25ec42d233b129cc570b4fa9.jpg[/img]

Taû’tael

notes.title: Patch Demo Branch, Improved Camera & Foci Menu
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Demo Branch players![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725869/4f0d3fb668ef0fe875225cb0cbfb104f7a83fd50.jpg[/img]

With this build, players should be enjoying a much smoother experience alongside improved FPS and find a more coherent, slightly more reactive world, with a camera that helps keep you better in the flow of combat.

There's also gradual improvements to animations and gameplay balancing amongst many enemies and weapons.

Here are the big changes to the current Live build:

[list]
[*]Lock-On now follows enemies in a different way, framing gameplay a bit better
[*]Foci Menu Improvements to Adrenaline Skill Selection, Phase Rock Insertion
[*]Skill-Tree UI Feedback
[*]Some Level Design changes to make the world more coherent
[*]Shortcuts that have been unlocked should now restore properly(not halfway)
[*]Two less texture samples used for VERY common architectural pieces
[*]Some Shadow casting optimizations
[*]A huge number of Distance Culling optimizations
[*]Custom HISM grouping optimizations
[/list]

Note that Archery Zoom may be worse on surface, but it's backend is entirely reworked to be more designer friendly. Look forward to a VERY refined experience in future patches as we can start tweaking it with our new tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725869/e5cb7d01660c77a89b128943a93412a7c3cbcd9a.jpg[/img]

Taû’tael

notes.title: Mini patch - Demo Branch, Re-added Character and Camera Invert settings.
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Demo Branch players![/h1]

When we updated the settings menu to work well for Ultrawide, we forgot to re-add Inverting controls and Inverting camera. They also previously did not restore on re-loading the game.

This should be fixed now, so you can enjoy all the inversions you want. Well. Not quite. We don't allow individual Horizontal and Vertical inversions, they invert together for Camera and Character respectively.

Tell us if this is needed for you to enjoy the game. 

[i]Taû’tael[/i]
